create_RAdam_optimizer: create a RAdam optimizer instance with configurable learning rate, betas, epsilon, and weight decay
run_RAdam_step: run one optimization step of the RAdam optimizer on model parameters with gradients
configure_RAdam_betas: configure RAdam optimizer with custom beta1 and beta2 momentum parameters
use_RAdam_with_weight_decay: use RAdam optimizer with weight decay regularization applied during each step
serialize_RAdam_state: serialize and restore RAdam optimizer state using __setstate__ for checkpointing
